prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CoBloom collectible mature memory flower for a mobile garden card. Create one real sunflower plant (Helianthus annuus), recognizable by large round dark centers, broad golden ray petals, sturdy stems and heart-shaped leaves. Do not mix it with any other species. Japanese storybook illustration, simplified botanical shapes, thick soft dark-purple outlines, flat pastel colors, minimal internal details, layered plant heights, rounded organic silhouettes, cozy mobile game aesthetic. A single complete plant, front-facing with a slight three-quarter view, centered, full silhouette visible, generous transparent padding, designed to fit naturally inside a miniature garden diorama. Show exactly 4 and only 4 sunflower flower heads total. Count them visibly: one top-left, one top-right, one lower-left, one lower-right. No fifth central flower, no hidden blossom, no buds. The four participant-linked blooms open outward from one shared branching stem. Palette: pitch green, night charcoal, trophy gold, golden-yellow, warm-orange. Use flat pastel fills and minimal internal detail. Event memory glyph: one small soft firework-like starburst floats above the four-head crown and one restrained warm-gold sunrise edge touches the petals. Emotional meaning in CoBloom: 比分属于赛史，那阵同时响起的欢呼只属于一起守到终场的人. Constraints: isHybrid is false; every visible element must belong to or gently decorate the single plant; no text, no letters, no logo, no signature, no UI, no people, no faces, no hands, no photorealism, no full garden scene, no room interior, no landscape background, no literal event props dominating the plant, no collage, no sticker-like objects, no mixed flower species, no hybrid anatomy, no cast shadow, no ground plane.
